mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile moment because it brought the systems together in a clear, everyday example of active muscle work and feedback.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the surface and supporting layers was predictable, and the result added little beyond showing their arrangement.

surprise.text: The explanation that the outermost skin cells are dead while living layers replace them added a useful distinction.

arbitrary.text: Completing the goal to cover the hand when sensitive skin was created felt premature, since the skin was only attached to the arm later.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered another concrete interaction like the slipping glass. Much of the assembly was predictable, though the final feedback example made the payoff interesting.
